# shoehorn_gitops_resources (Data Source)

Retrieves GitOps resources (ArgoCD Applications, FluxCD Kustomizations, HelmReleases, etc.) pushed by K8s agents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Argo CD applications and their sync status
data "shoehorn_gitops_resources" "argocd" {
  tool = "argocd"
}

output "argocd_apps" {
  value = [
    for r in data.shoehorn_gitops_resources.argocd.resources :
    "${r.namespace}/${r.name}: ${r.sync_status}"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Filter resources by cluster ID.
- `health_status` (String) Filter resources by health status.
- `sync_status` (String) Filter resources by sync status.
- `tool` (String) Filter resources by GitOps tool (argocd, fluxcd).

### Read-Only

- `resources` (Attributes List) The list of GitOps resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `total` (Number) Total number of resources matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `auto_sync` (Boolean) Whether auto-sync is enabled.
- `cluster_id` (String) The cluster ID where this resource lives.
- `entity_id` (String) The Shoehorn entity ID this resource is linked to.
- `entity_name` (String) The Shoehorn entity name this resource is linked to.
- `health_status` (String) The health status of the resource.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.
- `kind` (String) The resource kind (Application, Kustomization, HelmRelease).
- `last_synced_at` (String) The last sync timestamp.
- `name` (String) The resource name.
- `namespace` (String) The Kubernetes namespace.
- `owner_team` (String) The owning team.
- `revision` (String) The current revision (commit SHA or tag).
- `source_url` (String) The Git source URL.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the resource is suspended.
- `sync_status` (String) The sync status of the resource.
- `target_revision` (String) The target revision (branch, tag, or commit).
- `tool` (String) The GitOps tool (argocd, fluxcd).
